India Reaches Women's Asia Cup Semi-Finals, Faces Pakistan Next

The Indian women's cricket team has become the first to qualify for the semi-finals of the Women's Asia Cup. They are set to play their next match against Pakistan. The Indian team, led by Harmanpreet Kaur, has already secured its place in the semi-finals and aims to maintain its winning streak. The match against Pakistan is scheduled for Saturday.
